notes: Web search ran out after 22 searches (the session's limit of 200 was already nearly used). These eight were never searched for, only looked up on pages already known, so a blank means 'not looked for': Carla Couture, Chas Neff Jr, Brenda Jo Gillund, Terry Goerger, Bob Martinson, Tyler York, Terry M Wanzek, Kevin Horneman. No party endorsement page could be searched for either.

Nothing found, after a search: Ann M. Wadsworth, James (Jim) Small, James Stacey Jr (the courts' page names another person as Divide County Sheriff today), Irene Helm, Roberto Cantu (the courts' page names another person as Kidder County Sheriff today), John Hance (news coverage describes police and military work, which are jobs, not offices), Todd Lasher, Craig Jarolimek.

Brenda Jo Gillund: https://district13.us/ promotes her for House District 13 but is the District 13 Dem-NPL's site, not her own, so it is not recorded as her website. Kevin Horneman: https://www.bismanleaders.com/kevin-horneman-state-senate-district-7/ is 'paid for and authorized by the Bismarck/Mandan Dem-NPL organization', likewise not his own. The state party's page https://demnpl.com/2026legislativecandidates/ lists Gillund, York and Horneman as '2026 Dem-NPL Legislative Candidates' but does not use the word endorsed, so no endorsement is recorded.

Terry Goerger: Richland County's commission page names a Terry Goerger as chairman of the Board of Commissioners (https://www.co.richland.nd.us/commission/), but nothing opened ties that commissioner to the District 25 House candidate, so nothing is recorded. A verifier with search could settle it.

Michael Howe: Wikipedia's page on this race says the North Dakota Republican Party declined to endorse him (footnote to a March 2026 news story that could not be opened); not recorded. ndgop.org shows no list of 2026 endorsements.

Where an office has no 'from' year, the page names the person as holding the office today and gives no start date. Missy Morden is listed by the courts as Melissa Morden; Terry Ternes as Terrance Ternes; Matt Wright as Matthew Wright.
Several county sites failed to resolve on some tries (the router's lost lookups); bensoncountynd.com answered 429 and was left alone.

Verifier, 2026-10-02: every url re-opened and every finding confirmed. Ramsey County's sheriff page has moved (301) from www.co.ramsey.nd.us to www.ramseycountynd.gov; the address was updated. Tyler York's page carries his own committee's 'Paid for by' line, now recorded in 'how'. Nelson County's page says its commission is elected at large and gives no district numbers.
